[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT7 ]And that naivety is no bad thing.[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]I want you to remember this:[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]You are strong, Fiorung. And you[XENO:n ]

[XENO:act act=EVT1 ]I do. Thank you.[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]And I'm glad you were willing[XENO:n ]

Living happily ever after?[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
